title: Outside rows prove they run KRN's own core skills
body:
Source: .krn/runs/overnight/fable-skills-1115l.md slice 6
Why: nothing proves an outside repo runs the same skills as KRN.
Outcome: each outside row records the hash of its installed core skills; it equals KRN own; py, php, go and rust rows drain 0.
Files: scripts/outside-acceptance.ts or src/adopt/census.ts, test/adopt/parity.test.ts
Proof: four rows print a matching skill hash and drain 0.
Predicted: outside drain == 0 in >= 4 rows
